deviations.detail: Intent probes were batched (2-3 related questions per principal spawn) rather than strictly one-question-per-turn. The protocol explicitly permits 'a fresh principal subagent per question batch', so this is within protocol; recorded for transparency. 7 principal spawns total.

The adversarial review seat was dispatched as a FRESH independent subagent (mochiko:devils-advocate) that loaded review-specifications and graded strictly from the artifact files + a prototype walk, rather than the run-lead playing the seat itself from artifact text (the protocol's default single-agent mode). Rationale: a genuinely independent grader is a stronger author-not-grader fence than self-grading, which the protocol's independence requirement calls for. Net effect on judged artifacts: the review was more adversarial, not less.

The staged derivation output (.mochiko/specs/invoice-lifecycle/feature-map-delta/) was removed after the acceptance-time map write, because the live .mochiko/features/ entries are authoritative and the staged copies carried pre-acceptance ('will flip in-flight at acceptance') status lines that would otherwise read as status drift against the live map. The spec's Feature Selection section retains the full derivation record.

The FR/SC/edge-case layer (authoring-requirements) was authored in the stories stage, before derivation, because derivation must map every SC-XXX to its verifying feature (per authoring-feature-map's SC re-homing) and therefore requires the SCs to exist. Not a deviation from the command; recorded to make the seat ordering explicit.
